records.key: Annotations saved to png_list: {objects} objects in {databases} database(s).
records.source: Annotations saved to png_list: {objects} objects in {databases} database(s).
records.translation: Annoteringar sparade till png_list: {objects} objekt i {databases} databas(er).

records.key: Choose the project folder that holds the plate folders
records.source: Choose the project folder that holds the plate folders

records.key: Every annotation column is saved to png_list.
records.source: Every annotation column is saved to png_list.
records.translation: Alla annoteringskolumner är sparade till png_list.

records.key: Not saved: a measurement database is in use. Close what is using it, then press Save annotations.
records.source: Not saved: a measurement database is in use. Close what is using it, then press Save annotations.
records.translation: Inte sparat: en mätdatabas används. Stäng det som använder den och tryck sedan på Spara annoteringar.

records.key: Not saved: no plate database was found for {count} labelled objects. Press Save annotations and choose the project folder.
records.source: Not saved: no plate database was found for {count} labelled objects. Press Save annotations and choose the project folder.
records.translation: Inte sparat: ingen plattdatabas hittades för {count} märkta objekt. Tryck på Spara annoteringar och välj projektmappen.

records.key: Nothing to save yet. Annotate rows first: right-click the chart and choose Annotate selection.
records.source: Nothing to save yet. Annotate rows first: right-click the chart and choose Annotate selection.
records.translation: Inget att spara ännu. Annotera rader först: högerklicka i diagrammet och välj Annotera urvalet.

records.key: These annotation columns are not saved to png_list: {columns}. Closing loses them.
records.source: These annotation columns are not saved to png_list: {columns}. Closing loses them.
records.translation: Dessa annoteringskolumner är inte sparade till png_list: {columns}. Om du stänger förloras de.

records.key: This table has no prcfo column and no plate, row, column, field and object_label columns, so its annotations cannot be saved to png_list. Use Export table… or Save annotated table… to keep them.
records.source: This table has no prcfo column and no plate, row, column, field and object_label columns, so its annotations cannot be saved to png_list. Use Export table… or Save annotated table… to keep them.
records.translation: Den här tabellen har ingen prcfo-kolumn och inga kolumner för platta, rad, kolumn, fält och object_label, så dess annoteringar kan inte sparas till png_list. Använd Exportera tabell… eller Spara annoterad tabell… för att behålla dem.

records.key: Write the annotation columns to png_list in each plate's measurements.db, matched by prcfo, so Classify can train on them.
records.source: Write the annotation columns to png_list in each plate's measurements.db, matched by prcfo, so Classify can train on them.
records.translation: Skriv annoteringskolumnerna till png_list i varje plattas measurements.db, matchade via prcfo, så att Classify kan träna på dem.

records.key: {count} objects are labelled differently on several rows; the first label was saved.
records.source: {count} objects are labelled differently on several rows; the first label was saved.
records.translation: {count} objekt är märkta olika på flera rader; den första etiketten sparades.
